title: Ice cream and sunburn
story: Does eating ice cream cause sunburn?
crowdIs: 18 people at the beach. Each one went on a different day.

text.link: The ice cream eaters got sunburnt much more often. Look at the two columns.
text.draw: Draw the arrows you think are real. An arrow means “causes”.
text.test: Splitting the crowd: hot days on one side, the rest on the other.
text.reveal: Inside each pile, ice cream makes no difference to sunburn. Hot days cause both, so ice cream and sunburn turn up together. The link was fake.

hints.text: Look inside each pile. On hot days, eaters and non-eaters got burnt just as often. So does ice cream really cause sunburn?
Look inside each pile: sunburn and ice cream don't go together any more. Something else is behind both.
Can eating an ice cream make the day hot? Arrows point from the cause to what it changes.
Can getting sunburnt make the day hot? Arrows point from the cause to what it changes.
Look at the hot pile: almost everyone got burnt there. What does a hot day do to sunburn?
Look at the hot pile: most people had ice cream there. What does a hot day do to ice cream?

fallbackHint: Not quite. Watch the piles again and try a different set of arrows.
